scenarios.prompt: Author a launch that begins after the relevant hitstop and must produce the same arc independent of animation playback rate. Publish initial motion, gravity and air-stun data.

criteria.ownership: Owns intended launch parameters; collision response is delegated to knockback-body.
criteria.timing: Launch start relative to hitstop and logical state is explicit, not inferred from clip time.
criteria.evidence: Recorded initial state and measured arc are replayed across render rates before claiming stability.
